papers.title: Gombey dancer's note
lines: The Gombeys dance at Christmas in masks and bright tassels, to drums and whistles.
Nobody is quite sure of the story. Everybody knows the steps.

papers.title: Chowder recipe
lines: Bermuda fish chowder: fish, tomato, onion, a good dark rum and a splash of sherry peppers.
Add the rum at the table, not the pot. Then add a second one, for the cook.

trail.clue: A cook's tin of takings lies in the soft earth near the lobster pots. 'Under the oleander.'

papers.title: Captain's letter
lines: The Triangle is full of shipwrecks, which is simply because there are a great many ships.
I have never lost anything there but a hat and a sandwich. Both were stolen by gulls.

papers.title: Moongate postcard
lines: Walk through a Bermuda moongate with your sweetheart for luck, said the sailors.
I walked through with my cousin, who hates me. The luck is mixed.
